arms.loop_body: payload = node + 0x10; (scaled, clamped) = callee(payload, rsi, rdx); scaled_sum += scaled mod 2**64; clamped_sum += clamped mod 2**64
arms.loop_end: next node equals header: return (scaled_sum, clamped_sum)

callee.returns: (scaled value in rax, clamped total in rdx)

fields.terminator: next pointer equal to the header address

unknowns: element type of the list and meanings of the pass-through rsi/rdx arguments
callee internals beyond its (scaled, clamped) return contract
well-formedness of the chain (unguarded in-window; model requires header termination)
